reviewer: an independent reviewer agent that saw only the screenshots (no code); seven fresh reviewers in all, one per round
page: #/evolution/12124 (a licence with two published report years for Maths + SES)
screens: wide 1360 px light and dark (full page); phone 393 px light and dark, a bac techno phone and a phone without profile (first four cards)

colour_readability.why: Lines are clearly separated in both themes: navy/cream solid, rose dashed, grey dotted, teal/olive/violet for the bac routes. TB félicitations and Très bien are close dark browns; the % labels on the bars carry most of the reading.

colour_blind_safety.why: Every line chart pairs colour with a dash pattern repeated in the legend, plus squares/diamonds and hollow points. Small unlabelled slivers of the stacked bars rely on colour order alone.

personal_curves.why: The student's series are bold in the legend and tagged « vous » / « votre bac » at the line end; « Vos deux spécialités » is the heaviest line. On the mention chart the reference line is visually as strong as the student's dashed estimate; the « votre bac » tag sits near overlapping techno/pro lines.

legend_and_labels.why: Legends sit directly above each chart, axes are consistent (0-100 %, 2022-2025), the square/diamond key sits under the curves. The estimation chip, its button and its text read as three pieces; techno and pro markers collide near 0 %.

honesty_wording.why: « Des résultats passés, pas une chance », « Des parts d'admis, pas une chance », « rare, pas fermée » and « (estimation) » are plain and consistent; the header says « Taux d'accès officiel ».

hierarchy.why: A summary card (official rate 99 % → 63 %), then the two personal cards, then context charts and the counts table. Without a profile two prompts come first; the wide grid leaves gaps under shorter cards.

style_fidelity.why: Thick ink edges, hard offset shadows and Space Grotesk on every card in both themes, charts straight. The « Comment lire » accordion is lighter than the rest of the kit.

phone_layout.why: No horizontal overflow, cards fit 360 px, legends wrap cleanly, tick labels legible. Legends wrapping on three lines make some cards tall.

dark_theme.why: Cream replaces navy for the main lines, teal becomes cyan, techno yellow, all with good contrast. The grey dotted reference line and the top browns are weaker than in light.

overall_polish.why: Clean and coherent. Remaining: a tag near overlapping techno/pro lines, a series flat on 0 %, uneven card heights on wide screens, close browns at the top of the mention stack.

measured_on: EV1-EV9 all pass on the real warehouse, EV9 in Chromium (7 screens)
suggestions: Make the student's estimate the heaviest line on « Vous parmi les admis » and demote the reference line.
Offset coincident bac techno / bac pro markers near 0 %.
Spread TB félicitations and Très bien further, or hatch the top segment.
Merge the estimation chip and its text into one sentence under the chart.
Collapse the two no-profile prompts into one banner on a phone.
